namingConvention.tokenId: dot.path.flat — kebab segments, camelCase preserved within a segment
namingConvention.idRule: sha1(normalizedIntentKeywords + signatureFingerprint + platform)[:12]; logicalId omits platform

neutral.0.$description: Pure white; canvas/surface base in light mode

color.action.primary.$description: Primary CTA fill; AA on onAction

transforms.rule: cssVar = '--' + id, with each dot→'-' and camelCase→kebab. e.g. color.action.primary → --color-action-primary; fontSize.md → --font-size-md; space.md → --space-md
scalar tokens become a CSS custom property and a `token.<path>` accessor that returns 'var(--…)'
composite → applied via <Text variant>; not a single var
composite → single --shadow-<name> css var with the assembled box-shadow string

swift.target: DS enum namespace + Asset Catalog colors + ShapeStyle/Font extensions

transforms.rule: applied via .dsType(.<seg2>) modifier or Font.ds<Cap seg2>

indices.note: Populated by `node harness/manifest-tools.js index`; kept out of source to avoid merge churn.

decisionLog.justification: Swift codegen emits scalar tokens (DS.Spacing/Radius/...) and semantic Color extensions but not composite shadow primitives, so the .dsShadow(_:) modifier encodes shadow.{sm,md,lg} values directly. These literals are encapsulated in ONE token-layer file and are the single source for swift shadows — downstream code references .dsShadow(.md), never the raw values.
decisionLog.remediation: extend codegen.js to emit a DS.Shadow representation; then DSShadow.swift references it.
